title: Fairness Hacking: The Malicious Practice of Shrouding Unfairness in Algorithms
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It investigates a practice called 'fairness hacking' using synthetic and real-world datasets (e.g., Medical Expenditure Panel Survey) with sensitive attributes such as race, age, and gender.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
